content.title: Attempt to add a product while a required option is still missing
content.intent: Prove that add to cart is blocked until required options are selected and that the shopper is told which required option is missing.
content.technique_notes: Derived from the REQ-03 missing-option rule using negative/error technique plus eqp for the representative invalid state 'at least one required option missing'; bva not applicable because no option-count limits are specified; risk-judged strength=3 because the add-to-cart gate protects basket correctness, but no combinatorial expansion was needed because one representative invalid state proves the promised outcome.
